Diffusion Over the Whole Document

A next-token model writes a document left to right. Could a model draw it coarse to fine, the outline first?

iori1

1Jorik Jonathan Chase, 3DIE — Design, Art & Technologies Label. Paper 3 of a series. In preparation.

Abstract

In preparation. Paper 0 proves that a diffusion model of images settles the large scales first because the world's spectrum is a power law. This paper asks whether the same can be true of a document.

Where things stand. Autoregressive models write one token at a time; multi-token heads such as DeepSeek-V3's draft one more token, accepted 85 to 90 % of the time for about 1.8 times the speed, but the order stays left to right. Diffusion language models (LLaDA, Mercury, Gemini Diffusion) unmask tokens in parallel and are fast, over a thousand tokens a second, but the one study of the order they choose finds content words settled first and punctuation last: not an outline. Text does have scale structure. Its Hurst exponent is about 0.7 and falls toward 0.57 when sentences are shuffled. Nobody has yet defined the spectrum of a document or tested a generator against it. That is this paper.

Planned contents

  1. How text generators choose an order. Next-token, multi-token and speculative decoding; masked diffusion and confidence-ordered unmasking; the measured trajectories.
  2. The scale structure of text. Zipf, burstiness, long-range correlation, the Hurst exponent of literature, sentence-length spectra.
  3. The spectrum of a document. Document, section, paragraph, sentence, token: a definition that can be measured.
  4. Paper 0's theorem, transposed. What a power-law document spectrum predicts for the order of generation, and what it does not.
  5. The test. A prototype generator that settles a document coarse to fine, and the measurement of whether it does.

What already exists

  • Paper 0, chapter 5: the theorem on the order of generation, with live figures.
  • Lambda Cognition: the substrate this series builds toward.

  • 0.1Metafractal: The Space of Fractals Is FractalOctober 2026
